name: Busch Agricultural Resources - Idaho Falls ID Malt Plant

fieldNotes.truckGate: The main entrance off Yellowstone Hwy (S Yellowstone Hwy) is a long open access road that crosses the rail spur and branches into landscaped driveways with a monument sign on the median - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint structure visible in satellite at zoom 20. No Street View coverage exists on the access road itself (highway-level panos only), but every satellite probe of the entrance shows open, uncontrolled driveways.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance or anywhere along the access road in satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate exists, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The access road runs a long distance (300+ m) from Yellowstone Hwy across the rail and into the plant, opening into a very large paved truck-circulation yard - ample room to queue many trucks.
fieldNotes.scale: Malt plants receive inbound barley and ship finished malt by truck; a truck scale is operationally expected and a small structure consistent with a scale house is present in the truck yard, but it could not be confirmed unambiguously from overhead imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - a rail spur curves off the mainline (parallel to Yellowstone Hwy) into the property; a long string of covered hopper rail cars is parked on the siding alongside the malt plant and grain storage buildings. Rail is a primary mode for both inbound barley and outbound malt.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Not a dock-door distribution facility. Malt/barley moves via bulk loadout spouts and conveyors; estimated ~6 truck/material loading points/doors at the process and storage buildings (low-confidence estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated marked trailer-storage drop lot; trucks circulate through a large open yard. Set NONE.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple distinct structures on the campus - the tall malting/process buildings (~250 ft), a large segmented-roof grain storage building, grain silo/germination drum clusters, an office, wastewater treatment ponds, and outbuildings.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in open Idaho farmland (barley country) south of Idaho Falls along Yellowstone Hwy, surrounded by cropland - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural farmland setting but directly along a state highway with a neighboring industrial facility - cellular coverage likely adequate; set false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Approximately 7 distinct structures: tall malting/process buildings, large grain storage building, silo/drum clusters, office, plus outbuildings.
